articles.text: PÉNGYOU: Hēi, Xiǎo Liú! Hǎo jiǔ bú jiàn. Nǐ xiànzài zài nǎr gōngzuò ne?
FRIEND: Hey, Xiǎo Liú! Long time no see. Where are you working now?
XIǍO LIÚ: Jiù zài zhèr, Běijīng Túshūguǎn.
XIǍO LIÚ: Right here, at the Běijīng Library.
PÉNGYOU: Hēi, hǎo gōngzuò! Zài túshūguǎn zuò shénme?
FRIEND: Hey, what a great job! What do you do there?
XIǍO LIÚ: Fānyì.
XIǍO LIÚ: Translation.
PÉNGYOU: Yīngwén fānyì?
FRIEND: English translation?
XIǍO LIÚ: Yīngwén fānyì.
XIǍO LIÚ: English translation.
PÉNGYOU: Nǐ zhēn yǒu bànfǎ! Xuéle jǐniánde Yīngwén zhēn yǒu yòng le. Xiànzài zài fānyì shénme?
FRIEND: You're really something! Those few years you've spent studying English really turned out to be useful. What are you translating now?
XIǍO LIÚ: Jīntian fānyìde shi Huáshèngdùn Yóubàode yìpiān wénzhāng, xiěde shi guānyú jiàoyude wèntí.
XIǍO LIÚ: Today I'm translating an article from the Washington Post on the topic of education.
PÉNGYOU: Zhēn bù jiǎndān! Lián bàozhǐ dōu néng fānyì le. Nǐ yǒu shíjiān ma? Néng bu néng gěi wo jiǎng diǎnr?
FRIEND: That's amazing! You can even translate newspapers now. Do you have some time? Can you tell me a little about it?
XIǍO LIÚ: Wǎnshang wǒ hái děi xué Yīngwén, jiù néng gēn ni liáo jǐfēn zhōng.
XIǍO LIÚ: Tonight I have to study English, so I can only chat with you for a few minutes.
PÉNGYOU: Nǐ hái xué Yīngwén?
FRIEND: You're still studying English?
XIǍO LIÚ: Yīngwén bú gòu, bù néng bù xué ya!
XIǍO LIÚ: My English isn't good enough. I have to study!
PÉNGYOU: Shéi jiāo ni?
FRIEND: Who teaches you?
XIǍO LIÚ: Wǒ gēge jīnnián xiàtian cóng Měiguo huílai le, tā jiāo wo.
XIǍO LIÚ: My brother came back from the U.S. this summer. He's teaching me.
PÉNGYOU: Zhēn bàng! Duì le, kuài shuōshuo nèipiān wénzhāng, wǒ tīngshuō zài Měiguo shòuguo dàxué jiàoyude rén hěn duō.
FRIEND: That's fantastic! Oh yeah, tell me about that article. I hear that there are a lot of people with a college education in the U.S.
XIǍO LIÚ: Duì le, Měiguo shi dàxuéshēng zuì duōde guójiā.
XIǍO LIÚ: Yes, the U.S. is the country with the most college students.
PÉNGYOU: Zhēnde?
FRIEND: Really?
XIǍO LIÚ: Zhēnde, dàjiā yìfāngmiàn gōngzuò, yìfāngmiàn xuéxí, yǒu bù shǎo rén dōu wǔshísuì le, hái zài dàxué niàn shū ne.
XIǍO LIÚ: Really. Everyone works and studies at the same time. There are quite a few people who even at the age of fifty are still studying at a university.
PÉNGYOU: Wǒ xiǎng zhèi shi Měiguo jìnbùde yíge yuányīn! Zhèipiān wénzhāng nǐ fānwánle ma?
FRIEND: I think that's also a reason why America is so progressive! Have you finished translating the article?
XIǍO LIÚ: Kuài fānwán le, dàgài míngtian jiù fānwán le.
XIǍO LIÚ: Almost. I'll probably finish tomorrow.
PÉNGYOU: Néng bu néng gěi wo kànkan? — Zhōngwénde.
FRIEND: Could you give it to me to read? — the Chinese.
XIǍO LIÚ: Wǒ wèn yíxià wǒmende lǐngdǎo, dàgài méiyou shénme wèntí.
XIǍO LIÚ: I'll ask our leader. There probably won't be any problem.
PÉNGYOU: Nà míngtian wǎnshang liùdiǎn bàn, wǒ hái zài zhèr děng ni, bú jiàn bú sàn a!
FRIEND: Then tomorrow evening at six-thirty I'll wait for you here. And don't leave until we've met up!
XIǍO LIÚ: Xíng, bú jiàn bú sàn!
XIǍO LIÚ: Okay, we won't leave until we've met up!
